name: PostModule
doc: The group of settings one PostOverride entry changes.

variants.name: exposure
variants.doc: Automatic metering or a fixed exposure, compensation and adaptation.

variants.name: colorGrading
variants.doc: White balance, saturation, contrast, lift/gamma/gain and a lookup table.

variants.name: motionBlur
variants.doc: Blur along screen motion while the shutter is open.

variants.name: chromaticAberration
variants.doc: Colour fringes toward the frame edges.

variants.name: ambientOcclusion
variants.doc: Screen-space ambient occlusion strength and radius (presets that run it).

variants.name: reflections
variants.doc: Screen-space reflection strength and reach (presets that run them).
